description: Search the web, encyclopedia, academic, and code sources through one interface with automatic provider selection and a fallback chain. Use when you need broad or batched search, query autocomplete (suggest), query expansion (expand), ranked passages from the top pages (deep), or a multi-variant research compile that deep-reads each variant (research), and optional in-process analysis of the returned results (analyze: topics, entities, clusters, timeline). Do NOT use for a URL you already have (use infobroker_fetch_page), for high-stakes claim verification (use infobroker_verify_claims), for stored-report recall (use infobroker_manage_kb search), or for academic citations (use infobroker_get_citations). Caches results in the local knowledge base, enforces per-provider rate limits, and needs no API key for the free providers. `task_type` forces a dispatch chain (for example academic) when the automatic classification picks the wrong one. `fresh: false` keeps KB-first sufficiency, `fresh: true` skips KB recall and searches external providers, and `fresh: 'blend'` keeps cached KB results alongside fresh external results. `collection` scopes KB recall to a named collection. An array `query` is searched in parallel and merged, and a failed element is reported in `meta.per_query` without failing the batch. A measurable attribute (attendance, population, percentage, date) returns a sourced `facts` entry before prose, with `meta.fact_status`. Returns a JSON envelope prefixed `[OK]` or `[ERROR]` with status, provider, results, and meta.

analyze.description: Attach in-process analysis to the response: topic terms, entity mentions, semantic result clusters, and a dated timeline. Derived from the returned results only; adds no outbound request (default false)

collection.description: Knowledge-base collection to recall from (scopes KB recall only; ignored when fresh is true)

content_type.description: Source kind to search: docs, issue, changelog, blog, spec, or all (default all)

deep.description: Read the top results and return each page's ranked passages against the query

expand.description: Return query-expansion strings instead of search results

fresh.description: Knowledge-base recall mode: false keeps KB-first sufficiency, true skips recall and searches external providers, blend keeps KB results alongside fresh external results (default false)

language.description: Preferred result language (ISO 639-1, e.g. 'de'). Providers that cannot honor it report it in meta.ignored_params

max_results.description: Number of results to return (1-30, default 8)

priority.description: Route by intent: speed, quality, privacy, or free_only

anyOf.description: Multiple queries to search in parallel (max 5); a failed element is reported per input without failing the batch

query.description: Search query: a single string, or up to five strings searched in parallel

research.description: Research compile: fan out to derived query variants and deep-read each, returning passages grouped by variant (default off)

safe_search.description: Safe-search filtering: on, off, or strict (default on)

suggest.description: Return query-autocomplete strings instead of results (default false)

task_type.description: Force a dispatch chain by task type (auto-classified when omitted)

time_range.description: Restrict results to day, week, month, or year

name: infobroker_search_web
title: Web Search
